settings.description_override: A bookshop afternoon, a soft knit, plans left open. The Juliette brings suede and smooth leather together in a generous, gently slouching shape. Short rolled handles, loose front ties and warm brass-tone accents give it a thoughtful informality, for the woman who makes an ordinary day her own.
settings.fact_detail: Made by artisans with 10 years of experience

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: An open top, tall leather collar and short rolled handles define the Juliette. A decorative front strap, loose leather tails and brass-tone accents sit above the soft suede body. Carry it in the hand or over the forearm. The approximate overall specification is 18.5 × 18.5 × 8 inches.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Brush the suede gently with a soft, dry suede brush, following the nap. Wipe leather trim with a separate dry cloth. Avoid water and direct heat, and store loosely filled to support the collar and natural shape.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
